To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the military theorist uses scientific concepts and philosophical interpretations of those concepts to create a framework for investigation and a system of knowledge that is then used to create his theory.

(a) the military theorist uses scientific and philosophical concepts as frameworks for investigation and as systems of knowledge; and (b) the shift from the Newton-Cartesian framework of cause and effects determinism to the quantum mechanics framework of probability and trends will change man's concept and perception of the battlefield, thus emphasizing the capability for observation and rapid action.

1) science and philosophy provide the frameworks of investigation, and systems of knowledge, for military theorists; and 2) future military theories will be influenced by new definitions of force, space and time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between scientific theory, philosophy, and the military theory.
the links between science and philosophy, and their influence on military theory.
the relationship between the scientific and philosophical frameworks of the time and the military theory that developed.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the military theorist will be influenced by new science and new philosophy.

the future battlefield will be characterized by the rapid and accurate collection, processing, and dissemination of information and the ability to respond to the situation in a manner that will maximize the effect of the force.
the future of warfare will be characterized by a shift from the Newton-Kant-Clausewitzian model of warfare to a quantum-mechanics-based model of warfare.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the military theory of the future will be influenced by the new sciences of quantum mechanics, relativism, and complexity theory.
the future battlefield will be a dynamic environment of rapid observation and action, and the military theorist must be able to adapt to the new concepts and frameworks of the new science.
the new sciences and philosophies are changing the nature of war.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the future battlefield will be one of rapid observation, action, and adaptation to change.
military theorists must be familiar with the new sciences to understand the future battlespace.
science and its philosophical interpretation can and will have an impact on the future of military theory.
